properties.label: Peacewall
properties.Name: Peacewall
properties.Description: One of the peacewalls serving as a physical reminder of sectarian division and violence that still stands in Northern Ireland today. These walls and the meaning they hold in these communities have shifted from necessary boundaries to offset physical violence towards spaces for visual expression through muralism and graffiti.
